verdict.rationale: Segment documents a dedicated Profile API that gives a single API to read user- and account-level data. Per the docs, you can programmatically query the full profile object, including external_ids, traits and events. These profiles are built by Identity Resolution, which merges cross-device and cross-channel history into one identity graph. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Profile API behavior, endpoint-level reference detail (auth, rate limits, pagination) specific to the Profile API rather than the workspace-management Public API.
